title.en: christmas markets are open on albert square.
title.de: die weihnachtsmärkte sind am albert square offen.

line.en: the christmas markets run on albert square until early january. go in the late afternoon, before dark and the evening crowd.
line.de: die weihnachtsmärkte laufen am albert square bis anfang januar. am späten nachmittag hingehen, bevor es dunkel wird und der abendtrubel kommt.
line.tr: noel pazarları ocak başına kadar albert square'de sürüyor. öğleden sonra, hava kararmadan ve akşam kalabalığından önce gidin.

sparks.why: Manchester Christmas Markets opened 6 Nov 2026, with Albert Square listed to 3 Jan 2027 (Visit Manchester; Melia guide). Stall hours for this week were not confirmed, so the time is only a suggested start.
